tips.title: Define the CoordSys position for the Multiaxis machining.
tips.body: Set the coordinate system (CoordSys) to specify the origin and orientation of the tool path.

tips.title: Define Coordinate System
tips.body: Choose a coordinate system from the combo-box or select it graphically by clicking 'define'. The CoordSys Manager dialog box will display.

tips.title: Set MAC Number
tips.body: The MAC Number defines the number of the Coordinate System in the CNC-Machine. The default value is 1.

tips.title: Edit Coordinate System
tips.body: Use the CoordSys dialog box to change the location or orientation of the axes.

tips.title: Define Work Plane
tips.body: Choose the default work plane for operations in the Geometry page: XY, YZ, or ZX.

tips.title: Define Machining Surfaces
tips.body: Select the icon to display the Select Faces dialog box for defining new geometry or edit existing geometry.

tips.title: Define Floor Surfaces
tips.body: Floor surfaces must cover all the area above the area to be machined.

tips.title: Define Ceiling Surfaces
tips.body: Ceiling surfaces must cover all the underneath area to be machined and should not have any gaps.

tips.title: Define Wall Surfaces
tips.body: Wall surfaces must be the whole part including the floor surface, excluding the ceiling surface.

tips.title: Define Stock
tips.body: Select the Respect stock model check box to update the stock 3D model. Define stock using STL, surfaces, or 2D boundary.

tips.title: Set tolerance value for tool deviation
tips.body: Tolerance value can be set in the Geometry section.

tips.title: Expand or shrink stock model
tips.body: Use Shrink/Expand options to adjust stock size.

tips.title: Identify undercut areas in stock
tips.body: Enable the 'Stock has undercuts' option to optimize roughing strategy.

tips.title: Select tool for operation
tips.body: Choose a tool from the TOOLKIT table on the Tool page.

tips.title: Consider tool holder shape during path calculation
tips.body: Enable 'Check with machining surfaces' and 'Check with in-process stock' to avoid collisions.

tips.title: Define tool feed in F or FZ units
tips.body: Feed can be defined in Units per minute (F) or Units per tooth (FZ).

tips.title: Calculate FZ based on feed and number of flutes
tips.body: FZ = F / (Number of Flutes * S)

tips.title: Define spinning speed in S or V units
tips.body: Spin can be defined in Revolutions per Minute (S) or material cutting speed (V).

tips.title: Calculate V based on spin and tool diameter
tips.body: V = (S * PI * Tool Diameter) / 1000

tips.title: Define spin direction
tips.body: Choose between clockwise (CW) or counterclockwise (CCW).

tips.title: Define length offset number
tips.body: Set the number of Length Offset Register in the Offset table.

tips.title: Update cutting conditions for CNC machine
tips.body: Click 'Cutting conditions' to update settings based on the current tool and CNC machine.

tips.title: Define feed control parameters
tips.body: Click 'Feed Control tab' to set parameters for controlling the feed rate.

tips.title: Optimize feed rate based on surface curvature
tips.body: Enable 'Feed Rate Optimization' to adjust feed rate according to the surface curvature.

tips.title: Replace rapid movements with non-rapid ones
tips.body: Enable 'Rapid motion in Feed mode' to replace G0 commands with non-rapid ones using a particular feed rate.

tips.title: Change feed rate at first cutting path
tips.body: Enable 'First cut feed, %' to change the feed rate at the first cutting path.

tips.title: Define minimum feed rate for contour
tips.body: Enable 'Min feed rate %' to set the minimum feed rate of the contour.

tips.title: Define feed rates for direct/spline links
tips.body: Set determined feed rates for direct and spline links in the Feed rate for direct/spline links section.

tips.title: Define safety distance for approach and retract
tips.body: Set the Retract distance, Safety distance, and Exit safety distance in the Levels page.

tips.title: Define arc fit for sharp angles
tips.body: Enable 'Arc fit' to fit an arc at moves that go to the Retract distance and Safety distance.

tips.title: Define clearance area types
tips.body: Choose from Automatic, Plane, Cylinder, or Sphere based on machining strategy and part geometry.

tips.title: Set clearance area plane direction
tips.body: Define the direction of the plane normal vector using X-Axis, Y-Axis, Z-Axis, or User-defined vector.

tips.title: Specify clearance area plane height
tips.body: Set the height of tool retraction using Automatic or User-defined value.

tips.title: Define clearance area as cylinder
tips.body: Set the direction and radius of the cylindrical surface enclosing the drive surface.

tips.title: Define clearance area as sphere
tips.body: Set the radius and center location of the spherical shape enclosing the drive surface.

tips.title: Set retract and safety distances
tips.body: Define the Retract and Safety distance to approach and retract from the part.

tips.title: Use constraint boundaries for machining limits
tips.body: Limit machining to specific model areas using created automatically, manually, or user-defined boundaries.

tips.title: Define boundary type for constraint boundaries
tips.body: Choose from Created automatically, Manually, or User-defined based on the machining requirements.

tips.title: Set tool-boundary relation for constraint boundaries
tips.body: Control how the tool is positioned relative to the boundaries using External, Internal, or Center options.

tips.title: Define surface quality parameters for radial roughing
tips.body: Set cut tolerance, step down, maximum step over, scallop, desired step over, climb step over (%), conventional step over (%), and adaptive clearance.

tips.title: Define surface quality parameters for wall/floor finishing
tips.body: Set cut tolerance and maximum stepdown.

tips.title: Define sorting parameters for radial roughing
tips.body: Set the order and direction of the cuts.

tips.title: Define cutting method for multiaxis machining
tips.body: Choose between Zigzag and One Way. Zigzag changes direction, One Way maintains same direction.

tips.title: Select machining order for multiaxis operations
tips.body: Choose between Levels and Regions for machining order.

tips.title: Configure undercut machining for radial roughing
tips.body: Choose between Do not machine, Machine, and Machine only options.

tips.title: Adjust adaptive stepdown for radial roughing
tips.body: Choose between First Stepdown, Final Stepdown, and User-defined cut levels.

tips.title: Distribute intermediate slices in tool path
tips.body: Choose between Constant Stepdown or Number of slices.

tips.title: Smooth corners and links in tool path
tips.body: Enable Smooth corners, Smooth final contour, and Smooth links options.

tips.title: Filter small pockets and segments in tool path
tips.body: Choose between Inscribed circle or Diagonal length for filtering type.

tips.title: Calculate rest rough tool path for radial roughing
tips.body: Enter Previous tool diameter and corner radius or select the tool manually.

tips.title: Control contact point height for wall or floor finishing
tips.body: Choose between Preferred, Minimal, and Maximal options.

tips.title: Define ramping parameters for radial roughing
tips.body: Choose between Ramp angle, Ramp type, and Ramp length.

tips.title: Set minimum ramp diameter based on tool size
tips.body: Select 'Min. ramp diameter (tool diameter %)' to limit the minimum diameter of ramping movements to a specified value, which should be a percentage of the tool diameter.

tips.title: Define stock clearance for ramping movements
tips.body: Set 'Stock clearance' to specify the minimum distance from the tool to the stock during ramping movements.

tips.title: Allow tool outside stock for machining
tips.body: Check 'Allow tool outside stock' when using the Offset strategy on the Geometry page to enable machining around the part and on the outer side of the stock if they have the same dimensions.

tips.title: Define ramping priority sequence for approach moves
tips.body: On the Geometry page, select 'Ramping priority sequence' when using the Offset strategy to specify the order of ramp types during approach moves creation.

tips.title: Define first entry approach parameters
tips.body: In the First entry section, specify whether to use retract distance or safety distance for the initial approach movement.

tips.title: Use ramp for first entry approach
tips.body: Check 'Use ramp/Don’t use ramp' in the First entry section to enable or disable the use of a ramp during the initial approach movement.

tips.title: Define home position for tool path linking
tips.body: Set 'Home position' to specify the coordinates of the home position used in tool path linking for first entry and last exit.

tips.title: Define last exit retreat parameters
tips.body: In the Last exit section, specify whether to use retract distance or safety distance for the final retreat movement.

tips.title: Use ramp for last exit retreat
tips.body: Check 'Use ramp/Don’t use ramp' in the Last exit section to enable or disable the use of a ramp during the final retreat movement.

tips.title: Define connection moves between passes in the same group
tips.body: In the Within group list, select the type of connection move (Direct, Blend spline, Retract to feed distance, Retract to rapid distance) for connections within a single group.

tips.title: Define connection moves between different groups in the same region
tips.body: In the Between groups list, select the type of connection move (Direct, Blend spline, Retract to feed distance, Retract to rapid distance) for connections between different groups within a single region.

tips.title: Define connection moves between cutting layers on multiple heights
tips.body: In the Links between slices section, select the type of connection move (Direct, Blend spline, Step, Retract to feed distance, Retract to rapid distance) for connections between different cutting layers.

tips.title: Define connection moves between different machining regions
tips.body: In the Links between regions section, select the type of connection move (Direct, Blend spline, Retract to feed distance, Retract to rapid distance) for connections between different machining regions.

tips.title: Use ramp for first entry in wall or floor finishing
tips.body: Check 'Use ramp/Don’t use ramp' when using the Wall or Floor Finishing technology to enable or disable the use of a ramp during the initial approach movement.

tips.title: Define link types for gouge check
tips.body: In the Link page, select the type of link (Retract to clearance area, Clearance blend spline) for collision checking during wall or floor finishing.

tips.title: Set check surfaces offset for gouge check
tips.body: In the Gouge check page, set 'Check surfaces offset' to specify the surface offset value for collision checking during wall or floor finishing.

tips.title: Define clearance offsets for tool components
tips.body: In the Clearance data page, specify the clearance values for Shaft, Arbor, and Holder to ensure a guaranteed clearance gap between the arbor, tool holder, and workpiece.

tips.title: Optimize tool path according to machine kinematics
tips.body: In the Machine control page, adjust parameters like angle pairs and machine limits to optimize the calculated tool path based on your CNC-Machine's kinematics and special characteristics.

tips.title: Automatically choose angle pair with minimal angle change
tips.body: Check 'Minimum angle change' in the Angle pairs section to automatically select an angle pair that minimizes the angle deviation from the previous tool axis orientation.

tips.title: Specify control over the first angle pair solution
tips.body: In the Start angle type option, choose between 'Choose between two solutions' or 'Provide first rotation angle' to define how the first angle pair is selected during tool path generation.

tips.title: Set second rotation angle for better tool path optimization
tips.body: InventorCAM chooses an angle pair where the second rotation angle is closer to the Rotation angle value parameter.

tips.title: Configure machine limits for tool path control
tips.body: Options include No limits, Translation limits, Rotation limits, and Limits All. Machine limits are checked using the Angle tolerance for using machine limits parameter.

tips.title: Handle pole areas in 5-axis machining
tips.body: Methods include Freeze Angle around Pole, Use Rotation Angle around Pole to stay within linear axis limits, Linear interpolation of Rotation Angle around Pole, and Smooth interpolation of Rotation Angle around Pole.

tips.title: Set angle limits for output tool paths
tips.body: Options include No limits, Limit between 0 and 360 deg, and Limit between -180 and 180 deg.

tips.title: Control angular tool movements in calculated tool path
tips.body: Parameters include Angle change, Retract distance, and Retract tool to maximum.

tips.title: Interpolate points for linear tool movements
tips.body: Options include Interpolation for distance and Interpolation angle step.

tips.title: Limit rotation angle for machine head
tips.body: Using Max. angle step for rotation axis parameter to limit the rotation angle measured from the last tool path point.

variables.Number of Flutes: number of flutes on the tool
